# Parquetly

> A free online Apache Parquet file viewer that runs entirely in the browser.
> Files are never uploaded to a server.

Parquetly reads `.parquet` files locally using parquet-wasm and DuckDB compiled
to WebAssembly. There is no backend that could receive a file, no account, and
no install. It is open source.

## What it does

- Shows the schema: column names, Parquet types, nullability, and the full
  dotted path for nested columns.
- Shows row group and column chunk statistics: row counts, compressed and
  uncompressed sizes, compression codec, and encodings.
- Previews the data in a paginated table, rendering nested structs and lists as
  readable JSON.
- Runs SQL against the file with DuckDB. The data is exposed as a table named
  `data`.
- Converts a Parquet file to CSV or JSON, again locally.

## Pages

- [Parquet viewer](https://www.parquetly.com/): the main tool, plus how to open
  a Parquet file, why files stay local, and an FAQ.
- [Parquet to CSV](https://www.parquetly.com/parquet-to-csv): convert to CSV for
  spreadsheets and tools that cannot read Parquet.
- [Parquet to JSON](https://www.parquetly.com/parquet-to-json): convert to JSON,
  preserving nested structs and lists.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Gilbert09/parquetly)

## Notes

- Requires a browser with WebAssembly support.
- File size is limited by available browser memory, not by any upload cap.
